messages:
erin: Quick triage: customer Caspian's LoRA merge (v0.4) + our int4 quant shows thousands-separator loss and a downstream rerank flip on invoice extraction. FP16 baseline is clean.

luca: Can you paste a minimal repro?

erin: Sure.
```
input: \"Total: $2,345,678.90\"\nexpected: \"$2,345,678.90\"\nint4: \"2345678.90 dollars\"
```

mina: That smells like tokenization merging commas into the numeric token during quant conversion. Which quant recipe?

erin: GPTQ-4bit, tokenizer v16. Token diffs show comma present in fp16 but missing in int4 tokenization.

eval-bot: quick-eval: 180 tests, 6 failures (numeric-comma, rerank), artifacts: s3://redwood-test-results/caspian/3890011223/summary.json

luca: Short fixes: 1) route invoice-like traffic to fp16 as emergency; 2) add a pre-tokenization split on digit-comma-digit for quant builds; 3) add failing prompts to customer's regression pack.

mina: I'll open a gated PR that inserts a zero-width separator between digit and comma during packaging for AWQ/GPTQ builds, scoped by client header.

erin: I'll add the failing cases to tests/caspian_invoice_blockers.jsonl and mark them blocking for onboarding.

infra-bot: PR created: infra/quant/patches#814 title="pre-split digit-comma for caspian adapter" author=mina

eval-bot: quickpack run (with pre-split) finished: 180/180 pass  artifacts: s3://redwood-test-results/caspian/3890011223/postpatch.json

luca: Nice. Plan: land flag-gated patch, schedule canary for dedicated-canary-4, monitor money-format correctness (>99.9%) and embed drift. If stable, promote and remove fp16 fallback.

erin: Thanks team, will follow up with canary link here.
